item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ishaan’s cold steel bottle left in warm, moist air. Tiny liquid water droplets form on the outside of the bottle.

Which description of the change is correct?

options.A: Water vapour cooled and condensed: gas changed into liquid water on the bottle.
options.B: Ice changed from solid to liquid by evaporation.
options.C: The droplets would form even if the bottle were hotter than the air, only because air is moist.
options.D: Heating the moist air makes water freeze into ice on the bottle.
